instruction: Compare the main approach or family of approaches in this topic with relevant established alternatives found in the available sources. Use a structured comparison covering goals, assumptions, architecture or mechanism, required data or resources, evaluation evidence, strengths, weaknesses, and failure modes. Identify what is genuinely novel versus an incremental refinement. If the sources do not support a comparison dimension, mark it as unavailable instead of guessing.
